Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Zuran Orb (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
  You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
Steps: Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
  When Lumra enters, it triggers.
  Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
  When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
  Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.

Color identity: GW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 2 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite damage; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
Start: Druid's Call (battlefield); Cathars' Crusade (battlefield); Walking Ballista (battlefield); Primal Vigor (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Druid's Call attached to Walking Ballista.
  Walking Ballista has at least three +1/+1 counters.
Steps: Activate Walking Ballista's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
  Druid's Call triggers, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
  The Squirrels enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
  Repeat.
  Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista, you may remove them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

## Combo 277-3293-5414-5721
Cards: Emeria Shepherd + Aftermath Analyst + Tiller Engine + Troubled Healer
Color identity: GW | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 2 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Return all nonland permanents from your graveyard to the battlefield; Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Start: Emeria Shepherd (battlefield); Aftermath Analyst (battlefield); Tiller Engine (battlefield); Troubled Healer (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
  You control a Plains.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
  Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
  Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
  Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Tiller Engine trigger that many times.
  Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping each land that entered.
  Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
  Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
  Repeat.
Notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
